gate: Runs after shared runtime-only LoadSkeleton guard and before SKSE::Init/CommonLib GFx address use.
failure_behavior: Return false on missing file, path/file I/O error, BCrypt SHA-256 failure, or digest mismatch; no Scaleform settings bridge is registered, so native HUD remains available.
scope_limit: Hashes the bounded exact expected file; does not parse Address Library format or validate every relocation. No game state, camera state, or writes.
native_build: NOT_RUN by UI worker; parent owns Windows build.
